description: The Build Your Career AI Hackathon , organised by UnsaidTalks Education, challenges students to build innovative AI-powered solutions for real-world career development problems. The hackathon focuses on combining Artificial Intelligence with practical product development to create solutions that help students navigate their career journeys more effectively. Participants will work on building an AI-powered career development platform that can understand individual student profiles, identify skill gaps and recommend personalised learning paths. Join the Community: Join Here Core Focus Areas Artificial Intelligence and Personalisation Career Discovery and Role Recommendations Skill Assessment and Gap Analysis AI-Powered Learning Roadmaps Project-Based Learning and Portfolio Development Progress Tracking and Career Readiness Product Design and User Experience What You'll Work On Build an AI-driven platform that helps students answer three important questions: Where do I currently stand in terms of my skills? What skills do I need to develop for my desired career? What should I do next to achieve my career goals? Your solution should transform career confusion into a clear, personalised and actionable development journey. Problem statement will be revealed on 29th Nov at 11am. Why Participate? Work on a real-world problem with practical applications. Apply AI to build a meaningful technology product. Showcase your technical and product-building skills. Build a project that can become part of your portfolio. Get an opportunity to demonstrate your creativity, innovation and problem-solving abilities. Don't just build another learning platform. Build something that helps students shape their careers. Join the Community Be a part of the Build Your Career AI Hackathon community! Connect with fellow participants, get important updates, discuss ideas, and stay informed throughout the hackathon. Join the Community: Join Here

raw.details:
The Build Your Career AI Hackathon, organised by UnsaidTalks Education, challenges students to build innovative AI-powered solutions for real-world career development problems.

The hackathon focuses on combining Artificial Intelligence with practical product development to create solutions that help students navigate their career journeys more effectively.

Participants will work on building an AI-powered career development platform that can understand individual student profiles, identify skill gaps and recommend personalised learning paths.

Join the Community: Join Here

Core Focus Areas

  • Artificial Intelligence and Personalisation
  • Career Discovery and Role Recommendations
  • Skill Assessment and Gap Analysis
  • AI-Powered Learning Roadmaps
  • Project-Based Learning and Portfolio Development
  • Progress Tracking and Career Readiness
  • Product Design and User Experience

What You'll Work On

Build an AI-driven platform that helps students answer three important questions:

  • Where do I currently stand in terms of my skills?
  • What skills do I need to develop for my desired career?
  • What should I do next to achieve my career goals?

Your solution should transform career confusion into a clear, personalised and actionable development journey. Problem statement will be revealed on 29th Nov at 11am.

Why Participate?

  • Work on a real-world problem with practical applications.
  • Apply AI to build a meaningful technology product.
  • Showcase your technical and product-building skills.
  • Build a project that can become part of your portfolio.
  • Get an opportunity to demonstrate your creativity, innovation and problem-solving abilities.

Don't just build another learning platform. Build something that helps students shape their careers.

Join the Community

Be a part of the Build Your Career AI Hackathon community! Connect with fellow participants, get important updates, discuss ideas, and stay informed throughout the hackathon.

Join the Community: Join Here
